finding.summary: `getUsedBounds()` added as a required member of the `Store` interface; any implementation not updated in this diff will throw `store.getUsedBounds is not a function` from `Sheet.getUsedBounds()` during calculation
finding.evidence: store.ts adds `getUsedBounds(): Promise<Range | undefined>` as a non-optional method; only MemStore, ReadOnlyStore and YorkieStore are updated. `packages/sheets/src/store/memory.ts` itself references another implementation in a comment: "Unlike the `IDBStore` implementation, this builds the map from the entire grid." `Sheet.getUsedBounds()` blindly calls `this.store.getUsedBounds()` and `calculate()` awaits it for every formula cell, so any un-updated Store impl (IDBStore, test doubles/mocks in frontend or sheets tests) turns every recalculation into a TypeError.
